local_tests.note: No local C++/Linux toolchain; executable CLI and core tests ran in all ten cloud Linux targets.

limits: Linux x86_64 only; each CLI package uses its target distribution C/C++ runtime
No Qt, X11, Wayland, polkit or graphical session required; optional separate DKMS package
Simulated register/firmware tests and target-kernel VM tests are not physical motherboard acceptance
Only existing recovered settings are exposed; no new PStates/curve/Intel server/board-specific settings
RAPL/HWP writes report submitted values without firmware readback; OC reports checked register readback
Transaction serialization is process-local; no interprocess or kernel-wide mailbox locking
CLI UMC JSON is not directly importable by the existing GUI UMC snapshot importer
No cross-version package upgrade or Secure Boot enrollment acceptance
